instruction: I owed people some money. They put the associated expenses on Splitwise yesterday. I paid some of them up on Venmo today. Please record payments on Splitwise for each in their respective groups. Each payment should have a note, "Payment made on Venmo, receipt attached.", and an attached Venmo receipt of it as a proof.
notes: The number of Venmo payments made today that correspond to yesterday's Splitwise expenses is only known at runtime; the problem uses two placeholder transactions (txn-1/txn-2 with payee, amount, group and receipt path) and should be instantiated with one placeholder per matching transaction. Because quantified/conditional effects are disallowed, the listing APIs (venmo.show_transactions, splitwise.show_activity) set global knowledge flags that gate the use of the latent world facts in :init (venmo-payment-today, email-of, expense-in-group); these facts describe what the listings reveal, not prior knowledge. Each receipt is downloaded from Venmo into the file system (requires both venmo and file_system tokens), then splitwise.record_payment is called with payer=supervisor email, receiver=payee email, the Venmo amount, the expense's group_id, the fixed description note, and the receipt file path + file_system token so the receipt is attached in the same call (no new/updated Venmo transactions, no edited files). supervisor-complete-task takes the two task records (and the note) as non-API parameters so its precondition can restate the full goal; it must be last and takes no answer since the task asks no question. username-for/token-for are static helper facts that bind each app's credentials and returned token.

plan: (splitwise-record-payment matthew-blac-at-gmail-com payee-1-email amount-1 splitwise-token group-1 note-payment-made-on-venmo receipt-path-1 file-system-token payee-1 txn-1)
(splitwise-record-payment matthew-blac-at-gmail-com payee-2-email amount-2 splitwise-token group-2 note-payment-made-on-venmo receipt-path-2 file-system-token payee-2 txn-2)
